items: Seal attic air leaks at hatch and lights
Keep soffit vents clear of insulation
Roof-rake snow off eaves from the ground
cta_head: Let MyHome check all four for you.
cta_sub: Call or text 317-440-9258 or ask about Essential Care, $39/mo.
